title: RAW UNREVIEWED: s names a proper portion of its written material base across schor/chor and schol/s chol/chol
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_PARTIAL_C0. Across complete owned f22r.4-6, f32r.1-5 and f29v.1-4, author one local portion-introducing construction: chor is hypothetically reproductive-head stock, chol is hypothetically dried drug stock, and s(N) introduces a proper material portion of the written N. The two base meanings are new AA costs, not exported from schor's C1 image compatibility. In f32r schor selects the older chor stock rather than nearer chol; in f29v schol chol / s chol chol yields portion-plus-stock whereas the later unmarked chol chol yields stock-plus-stock. The referent-preserving entry rival yields stock-plus-stock for both. All 277 positions and alternate readings remain, 243 without lexical assignments. No whole translation, semantic test or global s rule.

design.unit: Complete f22r.4-6 (ZL22/IT22/RF21), f32r.1-5 (31/31/31), f29v.1-4 (ZL40/IT39/RF40), from existing O and Q packets only. f29v retains its GDT809 cleaned representation, not new diplomatic collation.

new_meaning_choices.chor: Reproductive-head material stock. NEW C0 base meaning; generic anatomy only, not flower/seed direction or an export from whole schor.
new_meaning_choices.chol: Dried drug-material stock. NEW nominal C0 meaning, replacing rather than silently preserving the older DRY predicate; not L/IDEA766 EXTRACT_STEP.
new_meaning_choices.s: PORTION(N): introduce material x with proper_part_of(x,N), x not equal N and a nonempty remainder. No extraction action or quantity is implied.

design.writer: Free s consumes exactly the next group within the same named paragraph. Only schor and schol are also licensed as s|chor and s|chol. The operand inside a derived word resolves to the same paragraph-specific stock as the exact bare base. No other s-initial word is decomposed. The five other free-s operand positions she/e/shot stay untranslated with explicit material-type obligations.
design.reference_contract: One stock per exact base per complete paragraph; embedded and free instances use the same stock. Forward reference is permitted inside that paragraph. C22, C32, L32 and L29 are distinct names of local variables, not an asserted cross-leaf identity. Each portion occurrence introduces a fresh existential. For the f32r nearest-stock contrast alone, additionally stipulate C32 and L32 distinct and its selected C32-portion not also part of L32; without this new separation assumption the rival outputs may coincide.
design.contrast: Proper-part introduction versus a referent-preserving entry marker with the same base meanings and boundaries. A secondary rival selects the nearest prior material stock instead of the written embedded base.
design.prediction: At f29v.2, IT schol chol and ZL/RF s chol chol reduce to P(L29),L29, but the later unmarked .3 chol chol must remain L29,L29. At f32r.4, schor selects C32 despite the nearer L32 mention at .3 G4. These are conditional authored referent consequences, not observations that establish PORTION or either noun.
design.smallest_next_step: Inspect the three declared reductions and all seven free-s positions manually with the complete unknown remainder retained. Decide whether a later written construction can take the portion rather than the owner under this same rule; do not add a predicate solely to manufacture a discriminator. No simulator, decoder, corpus query or reserve test is proposed.
design.unknown_remainder: 34 of277 positions use chor/chol/schor/schol/free s under this draft. The other243 have no lexical assignment; five of those only receive a material-argument type obligation. No qokchy extraction, daiin quantity, stem meaning inside qokchor, hidden equality predicate or source-output chronology is added.

GDT314/315 establish a physical-entry tendency, not s deletion or semantics. A referent-preserving entry rival is therefore serious and may be cheaper.
GDT759's measure-family meanings and 34 line-final s positions prevent presenting mandatory immediate-right material application as an already viable global rule.
The old chol state/quality account and IDEA766's iteration account are alternatives, not evidence for the new nominal stock value.
F/GDT1090 binds no substring and no drawn owner; the selected-union observation and9/15 sensitivity remain. GDT1080's fixed flower/fruit direction failed.
The third known schor, f42v.10 schor okchey within f42v.9-16, remains outside this offered construction. No full owner assignment there, distant reference or new target access is claimed.
The old f29v input is a cleaned full-paragraph projection. This card does not certify a newly inspected raw boundary or independent three-reader agreement.
O/GDT948 already distinguished source and product without identifying meanings. Here a written owner rule is authored, but unknown surrounding predicates still prevent a whole semantic test.
